description: Build up to 20 lineups for a Classic contest. Pass `example` (a sample slate) or `players` (the site's salary CSV text, or a list of player objects for DraftKings). Returns each lineup with its players, slots, salary and projected points, player exposure, notes about what defaults were applied, and `upload_csv`: a DraftKings/FanDuel/Yahoo upload-ready CSV string. Takes 2-60 s; if the result has status 'running', call get_lineup_result with the job_id. Lineups are optimal for the PROJECTIONS used, not predictions of results.

example.description: Use a bundled sample slate instead of players (names from list_lineup_examples, or just the sport). Live lookups are skipped.

exclude_out_players.description: Drop players the file marks OUT/IL (default true, as the web page does).

exclude_players.description: Players (name or id) to leave out.

live_lookups.description: NHL line combos / starting goalies and MLB batting orders / probable pitchers from the public sites the web page uses (default false: skipped; sample slates always skip). Can fail or be slow; a failure is reported, the solve still runs.

lock_players.description: Players (name or id) that must be in every lineup.

max_exposure_pct.description: Any one player may appear in at most this % of the lineups (100 = no cap).

min_salary.description: Lineups must spend at least this much.

n_lineups.description: Lineups to build (default 10, max 20: diversity cuts make each extra lineup slower and the free server is small).

id.description: Site player id (the number in 'Name (id)'). Default: name.

line.description: NHL only: forward line 1-4 / D pair 1-3; on a goalie, 1 = confirmed starter.

opponent.description: Opponent team abbreviation. Needed for rules that look at the opponent (goalie-vs-skater, bring-back, pitcher-vs-hitters, game counts).

projection.description: Your projected fantasy points. A player list has no site AvgPointsPerGame to fall back on, so every player needs this unless the top-level `projections` map covers them.

status.description: Injury status code as the site shows it (Q, O, IL...). 'O'/'OUT'/'IL' players are excluded.

players.description: EITHER the raw salary CSV text exactly as exported from the contest site (DraftKings 'Download players' / FanDuel players list / Yahoo export; a Classic contest), OR a list of player objects (site dk only).

projections.description: Your own projections as {player name or id: points}; overrides the file's AvgPointsPerGame for those players. Names are matched case-insensitively.

rules.description: Sport-specific rules, using the web app's option names. Each is tagged with the sports it applies to; a rule for another sport is an error. get_lineup_example(sport) lists the ones for that sport.

build_around_goalies.description: [NHL] Goalie names/ids; the batch is split evenly between them, each locked in.

build_around_pitchers.description: [MLB] Pitcher names/ids; the batch is split evenly between them, each locked in.

build_around_qbs.description: [NFL] QB names/ids; the batch is split evenly between them, each locked in.

confirmed_starters_only.description: [NHL] Only goalies marked as the starter (Line=1 / Starting).

consecutive_primary.description: [MLB] Primary stack must be consecutive in the batting order (needs orders).

cool_top_k.description: [NHL/NFL/NBA/MLB] Rest the K most-used players in each lineup (0 = off).

cooldown_window.description: [NHL/NFL/NBA/MLB] Players used in the last K lineups sit out the next lineup.

d_pp1_only.description: [NHL] Defensemen only from the first power-play unit.

declared_batters_only.description: [MLB] Only hitters with a confirmed batting order (needs orders; default false).

declared_skaters_only.description: [NHL] Only skaters on a line or power play.

dst_vs_attacker_exclude.description: [NFL] No skill player facing your defense.

forward_core_cap.description: [NHL] Max shared forwards with any earlier lineup.

goalie_needs_own_stack.description: [NHL] Your goalie's team must supply a stack.

goalie_overlap_cap.description: [NHL] Max goalie-side overlap with any earlier lineup.

max_stack_exposure_pct.description: [NHL/NFL/MLB] Max % of lineups any one team may be the stack team (100 = no cap).

min_unique_players.description: [NHL/NFL/NBA/MLB] Each lineup needs at least this many players not in any earlier lineup.

min_unique_skaters.description: [NHL] Skaters in each lineup that no earlier lineup used.

no_skaters_vs_goalie.description: [NHL] No skater facing your goalie (the goalie-vs-skater rule).

overlap_cap.description: [NHL/NFL/NBA/MLB] Max players a new lineup may share with ANY earlier lineup.

passing_core_cap.description: [NFL] Max shared QB + pass-catchers with any earlier lineup.

pitcher_oppo_exclude.description: [MLB] No hitters facing your pitcher (default true).

primary_stack.description: [MLB] Hitters from the primary stack team (default 4).

qb_rotate_window.description: [NFL] Do not reuse a QB within the last K lineups.

qb_stack_any.description: [NFL] Pass-catchers (WR/TE) from the QB's team in the lineup.

secondary_stack.description: [MLB] Hitters from a second stack team (default 0 = none).

skill_core_cap.description: [NFL] Max shared skill players with any earlier lineup.

stack_cooldown_window.description: [NHL/NFL/MLB] Teams stacked in the last K lineups are not stacked again.

stack_lines.description: [NHL] Forward lines / D pairings count as stack units (default true).

stack_pp.description: [NHL] Power-play units count as stack units (default false; much slower).

stack_teams_distinct.description: [NHL] Each stack from a different team.

stacks.description: [NHL] Stack classes as [[n_units, players_each], ...], e.g. [[2,3]] = two 3-man line stacks.

starters_only.description: [MLB] Only probable starting pitchers when the file marks them (default true).

strategies.description: [NHL] Pattern mix [{name, share}]; names: lineD_lineG_D, lineD_lineD_G, lineD_lineD_SAMEGAME_G, line_lineG_DD_different_games.

unit_overlap_cap.description: [NHL] Max stack units shared with any earlier lineup (default 1).

util_no_d.description: [NHL] DraftKings: UTIL may not be a defenseman.

site.description: Contest site (default dk). 'players' as a list works for dk only; fd and yahoo need the site's raw CSV text.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait inside this call (default 25).

name: build_lineups
title: Build DFS lineups
